case_requirements.query: verbatim source-native wording except preregistered deterministic composition transforms
case_requirements.memories: source-native context sufficient to make retrieval non-trivial; must include gold plus source-native or preregistered deterministic distractors
case_requirements.gold_ids: evaluator-only exact source-native IDs after adapter mapping
case_requirements.maximum_memory_rule: retain every runtime gold memory first, then fill remaining slots only with seeded source-native distractors; no Candidate-dependent hard-negative mining
case_requirements.deterministic_ordering: seeded hash ordering independent of Candidate output

source_context_rules.personamem-v2: gold related_conversation_snippet plus deterministic same-persona/same-topic first, then same-domain source-native snippets from the pinned benchmark pool
source_context_rules.longmemeval-cleaned: use pinned haystack_sessions as first-choice candidate memories; answer_session_ids are gold; if source record supplies fewer than five usable memories, fill only with deterministic same-domain LongMemEval source-native sessions
source_context_rules.locomo: use the same LoCoMo sample conversation messages as first-choice candidate memories; source evidence dia_ids are gold; if fewer than five remain, fill only with deterministic same-domain LoCoMo source-native turns
source_context_rules.sgd-carryover: use prior user/system dialogue turns from the same pinned dialogue as first-choice candidates; source-native carried-value support turn is gold; if fewer than five remain, fill only with deterministic same-domain SGD source-native turns
source_context_rules.evermembench-dynamic: use messages from the same pinned topic/date context plus deterministic neighboring source-native groups/dates; QAR.R exact references are gold
source_context_rules.rhelm: reserve only; use pinned source files/turns for the same persona and deterministic same-persona distractors; supporting_evidence exact references are gold
